svg.title: Direct paged verification replaces the gather, not the acceptance loop
svg.desc: M9b gathers cached KV and expands heads before Torch attention. M9c sends four queries, the physical KV pool, and page metadata directly to a causal paged-append kernel. Queries at logical positions five through eight see keys up to their own positions. Rollback and the next-forward replan remain explicit.

g.text: Keep the pages; change how verification reads them
One request • page size 4 • cached prefix C=5 • target inputs [4,7,9,2] at positions 5–8
Same model projections, RoPE, and physical KV writes
Q: [4,Hq,D] KV length: 9 Physical page table: [5,2,4] Pool: [pages,2,4,Hkv,D]
M9b: gather reference
Gather pages 5,2,4 into contiguous K/V
Trim unused tail; expand grouped KV heads
Torch attention over temporary context tensors
M9c: direct paged append
Q + existing physical pool + page metadata
Causal kernel loads referenced page tiles
No separate full-context gather or head expansion
T=1 uses paged decode; T>1 uses paged append.
Plan once; reuse across this forward's layers
query indptr [0,4] tokens
paged-KV indptr [0,3] pages
page indices [5,2,4]
last-page length [1] valid slots
Same causal rule: key j ≤ C + query row
Logits → unchanged acceptance code → private-page rollback
After rejection: rebuild the next plan from the current table and length. An old plan can reference freed pages.
